newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Engil boosts first-half orders.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Engil boosts first-half orders.

text.p: Portuguese engineering concern Engil-SGPS said orders at the end of the first half of this year rose to 92.7 billion escudos from 75 billion in the same period of 1995.
"Orders on our books at the end of the first half stood at 92.7 billion," Engil president Fernando Lima told Reuters in response to a query.
Engil's share price has risen sharply recently on expectations the company will soon announce first-half profit of between 600 and 650 million escudos, up from 586 million in the first half of 1995.
Profits are expected to grow more strongly in the second half of the year due to seasonal factors.
Lima declined to give a profit forecast.
By 1100 GMT Engil shares had risen 69 escudos to 1,460 on volume of 267,200 shares.
